prompt: Key art for PMM, a phone-to-phone messenger. A chunky beige 1982 home computer sits on a wooden desk at dusk, its CRT showing a deep violet-blue screen (#40318D) inside a lighter lavender-blue border (#7869C4). On the screen, in a blocky uppercase 8-bit bitmap font: 'READY.' then a blinking solid white block cursor. Leaning against the monitor, a modern smartphone shows the same violet-blue screen with the same cursor, so the two read as one family. Six thin vertical stripes, red #E8453C, orange #F28C28, yellow #F5D142, green #58B947, blue #2F86D8, purple #7E57B5, run down the left edge of both screens. Faint scanlines, soft CRT glow, warm desk lamp, El Segundo window light. Photographic, 35mm, shallow depth of field. No brand logos, no trademarks, no extra text.

Full-bleed straight-on view of an 8-bit computer boot screen, filling the frame edge to edge. Lavender-blue border #7869C4 around a deep violet-blue text field #40318D. Pale lilac #F2F0FF uppercase bitmap text, perfectly pixel-aligned on a 40-column grid: line 1 '**** POINTCAST MOBILE MESSAGING ****', line 2 'PHONE TO PHONE. NO SERVER IN THE MIDDLE.', blank line, 'READY.', then 'LOAD "FRIEND",8,1', then a solid block cursor. Gentle barrel distortion, visible scanlines, slight phosphor bloom, a single reflection of a window on the glass. Exact spelling, no other words, no logos.

A screen-printed gig-poster style announcement for PMM. Background deep violet-blue #40318D. Centre: huge blocky pixel letters 'PMM' in pale lilac #F2F0FF with a solid square block cursor after them, preceded by six thin vertical rainbow stripes (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, left to right). Below in small uppercase pixel type: 'POINTCAST MOBILE MESSAGING' and 'NO ACCOUNT. NO SERVER IN THE MIDDLE.' Bottom strip: twelve tiny symmetric 8x8 pixel creatures (like sprite avatars), each a single colour on a darker violet tile. Flat colour, visible halftone grain, slight misregistration, matte paper texture. Only those words, spelled exactly. No logos.

App-store style marketing screenshot. A modern smartphone, front view, floating on a lavender-blue #7869C4 background with a hard 8-pixel drop shadow in deep violet. The phone screen shows a retro messenger lobby: violet-blue #40318D field, a top bar reading 'READY.' with a block cursor, a card with a tiny 8x8 pixel sprite avatar and the code 'SIGIL 572E3ABB', a list of three friends each with a small pixel sprite, and a square chunky button with a hard white offset shadow reading 'LOAD "FRIEND",8,1'. Monospace uppercase type, square corners everywhere, faint scanlines. Headline above the phone in big pixel type: 'PHONE TO PHONE.' Clean, crisp, legible. No logos.

App-store style marketing screenshot. A modern smartphone on a deep violet-blue background, showing a chat between two friends in a retro 8-bit style messenger. Screen field #40318D. My bubbles: a slightly lighter violet panel with six thin rainbow stripes down the left edge; their bubbles: a darker violet panel with a lavender border. Under each bubble a tiny uppercase meta line like '9:41 PM · SUNNY · SIGNED'. A thin mood bar across the top blends blue and yellow. Square corners only, monospace type, hard pixel shadows. Headline above the phone in big pixel type: 'EVERY MESSAGE CARRIES THE MOOD.' Exact words only, no logos.

App-store style marketing screenshot. Two modern smartphones side by side, tilted slightly toward each other, on a lavender-blue #7869C4 background. Both screens are deep violet-blue #40318D and show the same large 8x8 pixel sprite, a symmetric coral-red creature, on a darker tile, with 'C6392AF0' beneath it in pale lilac pixel type, and a chunky square button 'VERIFY SIGIL'. A dotted pixel line connects the two phones. Headline in big pixel type at the top: 'READ IT ALOUD. TAP VERIFY.' Square corners, hard shadows, crisp. Exact words only, no logos.

Overhead photo of a vinyl die-cut sticker sheet on a light lilac backing card, lying on a desk next to a 3.5-inch floppy disk and a joystick. The stickers are flat pixel art with thick white die-cut borders: blocky letters 'PMM' with a block cursor and six rainbow stripes, 'READY.', '?SYNTAX ERROR' in coral red, 'LOAD "FRIEND",8,1' in yellow, a pixel heart, a pixel joystick, a pixel floppy with a rainbow label, six small symmetric 8x8 sprite creatures in red, purple, cyan, blue, green and pink, each on a deep violet tile. Soft daylight, slight vinyl sheen, realistic paper texture. Words spelled exactly. No logos.

Close-up of a phone home screen wallpapered in deep violet-blue #40318D with faint scanlines. Among ordinary blank placeholder app tiles sits one square app icon: a lavender-blue frame, a violet field, six thin vertical rainbow stripes, a blocky pixel letter 'P' and a small white block cursor under it. The label under the icon reads 'PMM'. A thumb is about to tap it. Shallow depth of field, evening light. Other tiles are plain unbranded shapes with no text. No real-world logos.

A grid of 48 square tiles, each a darker violet #352577 with one symmetric 8x8 pixel sprite in a single bright colour (coral red #FF7366, orange #F28C28, yellow #F5D142, green #58B947, sky blue #5AA8F0, lilac #B08CE8, cyan #6FD3E0, pink #F28CC0), like a yearbook of 8-bit identities. Under each tile, eight hex characters in tiny pale lilac pixel type. Thin lavender-blue gutters #7869C4. Perfectly flat, pixel-exact, no blur, no perspective. No logos.

A single 8-bit computer screen, straight-on, deep violet-blue #40318D with a lavender border. Pale lilac uppercase bitmap text, pixel-aligned: '?DEVICE NOT PRESENT ERROR' in coral red #FF8F85, then on the next line in pale lilac 'YOUR FRIEND CLOSED THE APP. SEND THE LINK AGAIN.', then 'READY.' and a solid block cursor. Scanlines and a soft vignette. Calm, dry, a little funny. Exact words only, no logos.
